item.title: Bridget Craig
item.description: Bridget Craig is a graduate from Northwestern University earning a Master of Science in journalism. She has appeared in outlets such as Military.com, The Fulcrum, United Press International, and WTTW News Chicago.She covers a variety of political issues, but focuses most on defense, veterans affairs, and foreign policy.Bridget grew up a military child, living in Germany and Italy until she moved for her bachelor's at the University of Miami.

item.title: Nick Mordowanec
item.description: Nick Mordowanec is a deputy editor for Military.com, reporting on general news and features across the U.S. Armed Forces in addition to investigative stories.

item.title: Darius Radzius
item.description: Darius Radzius brings more than two decades of experience in broadcast and digital journalism. He currently anchors and reports for 1010 WINS at 92.3 FM (Audacy, Inc.) in New York City, where his on-scene coverage of breaking news and public safety has earned multiple awards from the New York State Broadcasters Association and the Press Club of Long Island.

item.title: Ryan Thomas LaBee
item.description: Ryan Thomas LaBee is an entertainment and culture writer for Military.com, where he covers film, television, gaming, streaming, and pop culture through the lens of military life and veteran experience.

item.title: Elizabeth Rivelli
item.description: Elizabeth Rivelli is Military.com's Consumer Financial Products expert.She has covered insurance and personal finance topics for over 5 years. She has expertise across various insurance lines, including car, home, life, health, commercial, and travel insurance. With her in-depth knowledge and subject-matter expertise, her byline has appeared in highly authoritative publications like Investopedia, Forbes, Bankrate, and CNN. item.title: Brandon Wile
item.description: Brandon Wile is a writer covering the intersection of technology, health care and the military and veteran communities. His writing explores how policy, technology and innovation impact service members and their families.An Air Force veteran (2006-2012) who twice deployed in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom, Brandon holds project management certifications and has broad experience within federal and private health care sectors, including the Department of Veterans Affairs.

item.title: Derricke Dennis
item.description: Derricke Dennis is a veteran journalist and accomplished broadcaster with a number of family members and close friends who have served our country as members of the Armed Forces. Derricke's radio and television credits include CBS News, FOX News, I24 News, and 1010 WINS radio in New York City.
